question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of P. Only I sits to the right of Q. Only three people sit between Q and K. L sits at some place to the left of J but at some place to the right of O. How many people sit between O and J?
